name: Risk and scenario review
description: Add concentration, stress assumptions and escalation prompts.

steps.title: Risk register
steps.markdown:
# Risk register

For each risk, record the exposure, limit, current position, trigger and accountable owner.

steps.title: Scenario assumptions
steps.markdown:
# Scenario assumptions

Specify the shock, affected population, starting level and what stays fixed. Show the base case beside each scenario. Label scenario outputs as conditional estimates.

steps.title: Escalation
steps.markdown:
# Escalation

List the signals that invalidate the current view. Set a response, escalation owner and review date for each trigger.
